Revenue Outlook for Big Horn County
The revenue outlook for the impact area varies widely among jurisdictions. Increased tax bases due to coal mining have accrued primarily
to the county and to Hardin school districts. The increase in demand
for services as a result of in-migration of miners has principally
affected the municipal governments and school districts.
In order to analyze the past and future effects of coal mining on local governments, several steps are followed:
(1) the tax burden of residents is traced through recent years to discover any trends which may be present;
(2) the present status of the budgets of the local governments is described;
(3) coal impacts experienced in the past or anticipated in the future are discussed; and
(4) alternative sources of funding are explored for administrative units which have felt budgetary strains as a result of coal development.
